nodes.description: Private _transfer: applies bot checks, cooldown (block.timestamp), swap+ETH fee distribution, then moves tokens.
Private lockTheSwap swapTokensForEth: approves router and calls swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens.
Private sendETHToFee: splits contract ETH balance and transfers to _feeAddrWallet1/_feeAddrWallet2.
onlyOwner openTrading: sets router/pair, adds liquidity with ETH, enables swapping and cooldown.
manualswap: restricted to _feeAddrWallet1, swaps full contract token balance for ETH.
manualsend: restricted to _feeAddrWallet1, forwards contract ETH balance to fee wallets.
Private _transferStandard: computes r/t values, rewrites _rOwned balances, takes team fee and reflects fee.
Private _takeTeam: mints reflection share of team fee to the contract address.
Private _reflectFee: reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal.
Private _approve: validates addresses and writes _allowances.
transferFrom: transfers then decrements allowance via SafeMath.sub.
onlyOwner setBots: blacklists an array of addresses in bots mapping.
onlyOwner delBot: removes an address from the bots blacklist.
onlyOwner modifier: requires _owner == _msgSender().
Private _getRate: returns rSupply/tSupply ratio.
Private _getCurrentSupply: returns reflection and token supply values.
mapping(address=>uint256) reflection balances.
mapping(address=>uint) per-address cooldown timestamps.
payable fee wallet 1, also the privileged caller of manualswap/manualsend.
reentrancy guard flag for swap path.
flag enabling automatic swap+send during transfers.
mapping(address=>bool) blacklist enforced in _transfer.
max transaction amount enforced against buy-side transfers.
total reflection supply, decreased on fee reflection.
Ownable owner address used by onlyOwner.
constant total token supply.
liquidity pair address used to detect buys/sells.
Uniswap V2 router 0x7a25...88D used for swaps and liquidity.
flag preventing repeated openTrading calls.
flag toggling cooldown enforcement.
nested mapping of ERC20 allowances.
msg.sender / _msgSender() used for auth and transfer source.
block.timestamp used for cooldown and router deadlines.
_feeAddrWallet1/_feeAddrWallet2 .transfer(ETH) external value call.
External router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call inside token transfer flow.
External router.addLiquidityETH{value: address(this).balance} payable call.
amount parameter of _transfer.
from parameter of _transfer.
to parameter of _transfer.
bots_ array parameter of setBots.
contractTokenBalance local computed in _transfer before swap.
contractETHBalance local read in _transfer before sendETHToFee.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the 'from' address into _transfer.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender() to gate privileged functions.
block.timestamp participates in the cooldown gate inside _transfer (timestamp dependency).
cooldown[to] = block.timestamp + 30 seconds, a timestamp-dependent state write.
cooldown mapping value is required to be less than block.timestamp to allow the transfer.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not inSwap.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router call while only inSwap guards re-entry.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee after the swap, sending contract ETH out.
sendETHToFee performs ETH value transfers to fee wallets (untrusted external call).
ETH is transferred to _feeAddrWallet1, an external payable destination.
_transfer dispatches to _tokenTransfer/_transferStandard for balance updates.
_transferStandard subtracts and adds _rOwned balances for sender and recipient.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team fee share.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the reflection share.
_reflectFee performs _rTotal.sub(rFee) and _tFeeTotal.add(tFee) arithmetic.
_transfer reads inSwap to decide whether to execute the swap path.
_transfer reads swapEnabled flag before swapping.
_transfer requires !bots[from] && !bots[to] blacklist checks.
_transfer requires amount <= _maxTxAmount for buy-side transfers.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to detect buys and sells.
swapTokensForEth calls _approve(address(this), router, tokenAmount) before swapping.
_approve writes the _allowances nested mapping.
openTrading is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
openTrading performs an external addLiquidityETH payable call with the whole ETH balance.
openTrading assigns the hardcoded router to uniswapV2Router.
openTrading creates and stores the uniswapV2Pair address.
openTrading sets tradingOpen = true.
manualswap authorization depends on _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorization depends on _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract token balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
transferFrom calls _transfer(sender, recipient, amount).
transferFrom calls _approve to decrease the allowance.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] for the allowance check.
setBots writes true into the bots mapping for each listed address.
delBot writes false into the bots mapping.
setBots is guarded by onlyOwner.
delBot is guarded by onlyOwner.
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable for the authorization check.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply to obtain rSupply and tSupply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal as the reflection supply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _tTotal as the token supply.
ETH transfer to the fee wallet can call back into the token transfer entry points before state settles.
_transfer consumes the amount parameter.
_transfer consumes the from parameter for balance and bot checks.
_transfer consumes the to parameter for cooldown and pair checks.
setBots iterates over the bots_ array parameter.
contractTokenBalance is computed in _transfer via balanceOf(address(this)).
contractETHBalance is read in _transfer as address(this).balance.
_takeTeam adds the team reflection amount into _rOwned[address(this)].

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter amount is only used by _transfer; fold it into the _transfer function node.
Parameter from is only used by _transfer; fold it into the _transfer function node.
Parameter to is only used by _transfer; fold it into the _transfer function node.
Parameter bots_ is only used by setBots; fold it into the setBots function node.
Local contractTokenBalance is produced in _transfer solely to feed swapTokensForEth; merge into that unsafe swap operation path.
Local contractETHBalance is passed directly to sendETHToFee; merge into the sendETHToFee function node.
